In this video we cover:
Tata Motors’ Biggest Acquisition: Why It’s Buying Iveco
Tata Motors is acquiring Iveco’s commercial vehicle business for €3.8 billion—its largest deal ever, aimed at reducing dependence on India’s cyclical CV market and gaining advanced EV tech. Meanwhile, Iveco is exiting due to high R&D costs and a shift toward defence. This video breaks down why Tata is buying, why Iveco is selling, and what it means for both.
